jobs.title: AI Full Stack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

AI Full Stack Engineer

(€60K – €130K)

About the Role

You will build and iterate on internal tools and products, integrating AI capabilities into our systems. The focus is on strong engineering with a clear AI angle: working across the stack, connecting to AI APIs, and collaborating with business stakeholders to improve their workflows.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain full stack applications (front end, back end, databases)

  • Architect durable AI workflows that adapt as the LLM landscape evolves, not brittle prompt chains

  • Build and maintain back-end services in Node.js or Python

  • Integrate and orchestrate AI APIs into existing and new systems

  • Work across multiple systems and data sources, making sense of fragmented data

  • Collaborate with business teams (e.g. marketing, UA, operations) to:

    • Understand their work and tools

    • Identify where AI can improve their workflows

    • Translate needs into technical solutions and iterate on them

Must-Haves

  • Ability to communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience building complex agentic systems

  • Experience integrating and working with AI APIs

  • Strong coding skills and solid engineering fundamentals

  • Full stack capabilities: front end, back end, databases

  • Good prompting skills and ability to use current AI tools effectively

  • Production experience with Node.js or Python

  • Curiosity, initiative, and strong learning mindset (especially around AI)

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with TypeScript

  • Familiarity with agentic/system-thinking approaches for AI solutions

  • Experience partnering closely with marketing, UA, or other business/ops teams

What We Value

  • Engineering-first mindset, with the ability to understand business context

  • Proactive approach: going to people, understanding their work, and suggesting improvements

  • Comfort with ambiguity and evolving requirements

  • Strong communication and collaboration across teams

Why Almedia?

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

We're looking for Frontend Engineers from junior to staff level

jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

Berlin, On-site
€60K – €85K + Equity

Most Junior Data Scientists spend their first years building dashboards and reporting on what already happened. Here, you'll work on models that run in production and shape what millions of users see every day.

You'll join a small team of people who have built and shipped ML systems at scale, and learn from them directly. You get real problems from week one, and the support to solve them. Show us you can own more, and we'll give you more.

 

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Build models that predict user value, engagement and reward behaviour, and see them live in our product

  • Run A/B tests on offers, rewards and ranking, and work out what actually caused the result

  • Build and fix the data pipelines your models depend on

  • Take on new problems with no playbook yet, from first idea to production

 

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Strong Python and SQL. You use AI tools to move faster, and you still check the output

  • You get going on a vague problem without waiting for a spec, and you take it further than you were asked

  • You quickly see which number matters and which question to answer first

  • Proof that you aim high: a project, result or choice where you went past "good enough" when nobody asked you to

  • Bonus: a strong result in a Kaggle challenge, hackathon or competition, or a system you built and fixed yourself when it broke

 

Why Almedia

  • A small, selective team of very sharp people. We keep it small on purpose, so every hire raises the bar

  • Equity in Almedia. Every Berlin-based employee gets a stake, so you share in what you help build

  • Top-of-market pay as the baseline. Outlier impact gets paid accordingly

     

Small team, high bar. If that sounds like home, apply.

 
 

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Most junior engineers take years to earn full ownership. Here as all our engineers, you will have real impact from week one and be a part of a team shipping a product millions of people use every day. Your first 12 months compress what takes 3 years elsewhere.

You'll join a small team of engineers who have built and shipped at scale, with the support to learn fast. Show us you can own more, and we'll give you more.

We're looking for AI-native Junior Software Engineers who know how to build with AI tools, with different focus points, so you can pick your track:

    • If you love building things people see and use.

    • You'll build features in our web and mobile apps, test what works with real users.

    • You'll need: strong TypeScript understanding with a focus on either Node.Js or React.Js.

  2. Python (Backend):

    • If you love building the systems behind the app.

    • You'll build the services that handle rewards, offers, and payments for millions of users.

    • You'll need: strong Python and SQL.

  3. DevOps:

    • If you love building the tools that help everyone else ship.

    • You'll build the CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and AI tooling our engineers use every day, and make them faster and safer.

    • You'll need: strong TypeScript, Python, or Rust; Kubernetes or GitHub Actions is a plus.

  4. AI:

    • If you love building with LLMs and want to see them work in production.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer - Data
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

Berlin, On-site Top-of-Market Compensation - Exceptional commitment deserves exceptional reward

 

Most junior data engineers start by maintaining pipelines someone else designed, working through a ticket queue, and sitting several steps away from the product. Here, you'll build the pipelines and services that run live and feed what millions of users see every day. You'll take the engineering fundamentals you've built and apply them to problems at scale. Your first 12 months compress what takes 3 years elsewhere.

 

You'll join a small team of engineers who have built and run data platforms at scale. You'll work on real problems from week one with the support to solve them. Show us you can own more, and we'll give you more.

 

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship data pipelines that run live in production, from ingestion to storage, across near-real-time and batch workloads.

  • Build Python services and APIs that other teams and products rely on.

  • Work with operational databases and learn to run them under real production load: schema design, reliability, and performance.

  • Build tests, monitoring, and data quality checks that catch problems before a stakeholder has to tell you.

  • Help keep a warehouse of hundreds of terabytes fast, reliable, and cost-efficient.

  • Own undefined data problems from first idea to production. No playbook. You own it all.

 

What You'll Bring

  • Strong Python and SQL. You use AI tools to move faster, and you still verify the output.

  • Proof of depth as an engineer: a degree in computer science or a related field, internships, open-source work, a thesis, or a system you built yourself and kept running.

  • Hands-on experience with a database beyond the basics (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar). You understand schemas, indexes, and what breaks under load.

  • You get going on a vague problem without waiting for a spec, and you take it further than you were asked.

  • You think about reliability. You debug rigorously when things break, and you want to know why before you fix it.

  • Bonus: Kafka or Pub/Sub, dbt, Docker, Terraform, competition results, or a project you built and hardened yourself.

 

Why Almedia

  • Grow at Almedia: profitable from launch, higher revenue per employee than Big Tech.

QA Lead

€90K – €130K

About the role

We're looking for a hands on QA Lead who sees quality as a product problem, not just a testing problem. This isn't a traditional QA role focused solely on executing test cases or building automation frameworks. Instead, you'll own quality end-to-end, sitting between Product and Engineering to ensure we ship fast without compromising user experience.

You'll be given problems, not step-by-step instructions. We need someone who is highly autonomous, product-minded, engineering-oriented, and AI-native. We are looking for someone who can identify where quality risks exist, decide how best to solve them, and implement the right processes, tooling, and testing strategy.

You'll shape how quality is approached across the business, introducing AI-enabled testing practices, improving release confidence, coordinating an outsourced QA function, and defining where manual testing, automation, and production monitoring each provide the most value. While experience with Playwright and test automation is important, we're not looking for a pure automation engineer—we're looking for someone who understands the bigger picture of delivering exceptional products.

 
 

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Own quality across the entire product lifecycle, from feature design through to production monitoring,

  • Develop and execute a modern QA strategy that balances manual testing, automation, and production observability.

  • Introduce AI-powered tools and workflows to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and speed.

  • Build and maintain end-to-end automated test suites.

  • Decide where manual exploratory testing delivers the highest value and ensure critical user journeys are thoroughly validated.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to identify risks early and embed quality into development rather than treating it as a final step.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Strong experience owning software quality in modern product teams.

  • Experience balancing manual testing, automation, and production monitoring rather than specialising exclusively in one area.

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests, ideally using Playwright.

  • A solid understanding of modern QA practices, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and testing strategies.

  • Experience introducing AI tools or AI-assisted workflows into software testing and quality processes.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence Product and Engineering teams through data and practical decision-making.

 

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • You naturally move between product discussions and technical implementation.

  • You're excited by using AI to rethink how QA should work rather than simply doing QA faster.

  • You know when automation is the right answer and when manual testing creates more value.

  • You thrive in ambiguous environments where you're trusted to figure things out rather than follow predefined processes.

  • You're pragmatic, highly autonomous, and motivated by solving real customer problems.

  • You enjoy building systems, improving processes, and leaving the quality function in a significantly better place than you found it.

AI OPERATIONS SPECIALIST

Salary range: €70,000-90,000/annum



We are seeking an exceptionally driven and entrepreneurial AI Operations Specialist to work directly with our leadership team, leading and building large-scale strategic projects from the ground up at Almedia. This isn't a classic job; it's a pivotal role for someone ready to commit fully to delivering significant impact, pushing boundaries, and seeing their ideas come to life.


In addition to leading core strategic initiatives, this role carries a strong AI focus. We are looking for someone operationally excellent but also technically strong and hands-on - a hard worker who can actively drive and execute AI initiatives across teams. You will not only shape strategy but also help translate AI opportunities into practical implementation, ensuring measurable business impact.



WHAT YOU’LL DO  🎯

 - Lead high-priority projects: Take full ownership of key projects from start to finish, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with company goals.

 - Drive AI initiatives across the organisation: Identify, scope, and execute AI-driven projects that improve operational efficiency, user acquisition performance, product innovation, and decision-making processes. Act as the bridge between business needs and technical execution.

 - Develop a deep understanding of the business: Engage with all aspects of the company, from user acquisition to product development, to gain a comprehensive view of how the business operates - and identify where AI can unlock leverage.

 - Facilitate cross-departmental coordination: Ensure smooth communication and alignment between internal teams on objectives, timelines, resource needs, and AI project implementation.

 - Optimise operational efficiency: Identify and implement strategies including automation and AI-driven workflows  to enhance productivity and streamline processes.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING 💡

 - Experience in project management, operations, user acquisition, business development, business strategy, or AI-driven initiatives.

 - You're absolutely obsessed with AI and spend every minute you can researching and exploring the latest news and tools.

 - Ability to lead and execute projects independently, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.

 - Strong business acumen with a solid understanding of business operations, product development, and user acquisition.

 - Hands-on mindset with the capability to translate AI concepts into practical execution (e.g., automation, AI tools, data workflows, experimentation).

 - Analytical mindset: Able to extract insights from data and make strategic decisions based on business intelligence.

 - Excellent communication skills for collaborating across departments and with the leadership team.




WHY ALMEDIA? 🎁

 - Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

 - Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

 - Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.



We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

 

Director of Product & Design

Salary range: €130,000-180,000/annum

We're looking for a highly hands-on and influential Director of Product & Design to join our team in Berlin. This pivotal role sits at the intersection of product and design: you'll own end-to-end product experiences from the problem worth solving through to the pixels users see, shape both our product and design strategy, and lead and uplevel our Design team. You'll combine a product mindset with the craft to make it exceptional. You're equally at home defining a product bet and refining an interaction.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Own Product Areas End to End: Take full ownership of key parts of the Freecash experience, from discovery, problem framing, and prioritisation through to design, launch, and iteration, with clear accountability for the outcomes, not just the output.

  • Shape Product & Design Strategy: Partner with leadership, Engineering, and Data to define where our products should go next, drawing on user insight, competitor landscapes, and business goals to decide what to build, what to cut, and how it should feel.

  • Lead & Uplevel the Design Team: Act as a hands-on leader, coaching and mentoring designers to raise the bar for visual and interaction design, while growing their product thinking so the team owns problems, not just screens.

  • Run Experiments That Move Metrics: Turn ideas into hypotheses and hypotheses into fast experiments, using user research, automated metric tracking, and performance data to make decisions that move engagement, retention, and monetisation for users and advertisers.

  • Drive AI-Native Ways of Working: Bring AI into how product and design operate, from rapid prototyping and research synthesis to faster iteration, and explore where AI can create better experiences for our users.

  • Own & Enhance the Experience: Proactively identify opportunities across our products, then define, redesign, and ship solutions that improve usability, emotional connection, and overall user satisfaction.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Extensive experience across product and design in mobile-first B2C products, with a portfolio and track record that show both impactful UI/UX work and product decisions that moved business results.

  • Experience owning product outcomes, whether as a product manager, a product-minded design lead, or in a hybrid role: defining problems, setting priorities, writing specs, and making trade-off calls.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design skills, with a meticulous eye for detail, hierarchy, and accessibility, and a deep care for quality and polish.

  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and grow a design team, and to inspire cross-functional teams toward high-quality outcomes.

  • A highly data-driven mindset: comfortable digging into the data yourself, designing experiments, and setting up the metrics that show what truly moves the needle.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to speed up how you and your team discover, prototype, and ship.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Product Mind, Designer's Eye: You think in problems, bets, and outcomes, and you can't let a feature ship until it looks and feels right. You move comfortably between the strategy and the details.

  • Highly Hands-On & Quality-Obsessed: You naturally dive in, aren't satisfied until things are polished, and actively fix what doesn't look or feel right.

  • Impact-Driven & Business-Minded: You're passionate about seeing your work move real metrics and deeply curious about how product and design decisions drive growth for users and advertisers.

  • Built for Pace: You've thrived in fast-moving, lean startup or scale-up environments where ownership, speed, and ambiguity are the norm.

  • Proactive & Emotionally Intelligent: You take full ownership, seek out improvements, and think constantly about how users feel, creating rewarding and motivating experiences.

Why Almedia? 🚀

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our CEO checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

  • Run the ROAS dial. Tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Translate cap-fill outcomes and retention targets into bid moves. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Catch problems before advertisers do. Know what each account should do next before they ask. Push budget increases, geo expansions, format tests on a schedule. Intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Translate between commercial and technical teams. When a partner reports cost-data drift, you debug, push our engineering teams for an ETA, and frame the response back to the partner.

  • Ship the playbook. Document improvements to the Growth team's standard operating procedures every week.

 

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our Director or CEO. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Senior team treats you as the named owner. You're already covering for a peer's vacation. You've spotted at least one non-obvious revenue lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: Within a few years, the path runs from regional accounts to country ownership to multi-country or vertical leadership (gaming, non-gaming) to regional head (EMEA) or global.

 

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You're an underdog by nature. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. A 15% cohort revenue drop on a daily view? You spot it in under 30 seconds and you explain it in two sentences a non-technical listener gets. #datastoryteller

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

  • Language Proficiency: Fluency in English and Chinese is required.

Bonus points if you:

  • Know your way around platform-marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, and ARPU. If you don't yet, you will by week 2- we'll onboard you on the math.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have hands-on experience with MMPs like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular. You can read postbacks, navigate attribution disputes, and explain View-Through Attribution to a confused partner.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way, for example taking a €2M/yr account book to €8M/yr in 18 months.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up Senior Associate background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

 

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  1. Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.

  2. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it.

  3. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict.

  4. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing.

  5. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to.

 

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

Staff Data Scientist

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist with high ownership to work on meaningful challenges at scale.

You spot leverage points others miss: measurement systems that unlock pricing, experimentation infrastructure that multiplies output, causal models that rewrite unit economics. You own these end to end.

We value diverse technical lenses. Whether you are:

  • Causal inference specialist: propensity matching, DID, synthetic control, IV estimation. You turn observational chaos into rigorous insight.

  • Experimentation architect: designing multi-arm tests, MMM, MTA, uplift modelling. You define statistical rigor.

  • Systems thinker: building reward structures, pricing algorithms, ranking functions that balance engagement, conversion, and sustainable ROAS.

  • Zero to one builder: taking vague business questions into production data products.

What You'll Own

  • Measurement strategy. Design causal frameworks that reveal unit economics, attribution, and intervention impact. Own the gold standard documentation so others ship faster.

  • Experimentation infrastructure. Build platforms that enable rapid iteration and define statistical rigor without sacrificing speed.

  • High leverage models. Identify and own the models that move unit economics: pricing, ranking, user incentive systems. Partner with engineering to productionize rigorously.

  • Technical leadership. Mentor junior data scientists. Set the bar for how we think about causality, measurement, and trade offs. Drive clarity when stakeholders disagree.

  • Cross functional influence. Work alongside Product, Engineering, and Leadership to turn data insight into business action.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven autonomy. Track record moving unit economics through novel approaches. You own problems end to end.

  • Causal thinking. Deep experience with causal inference techniques (propensity matching, DID, synthetic control, IV estimation). You reason about causality, not just fit models.

  • Experimentation expertise. Led complex multi-arm experiments and designed or owned MMM, MTA, or uplift modelling systems. You understand type I and type II error costs.

  • Production maturity. Built and deployed models in product environments (Gaming, AdTech, user incentive systems preferred). You own metrics, monitoring, and decay.

  • Data engineering fluency. Comfortable with modern data stacks (dbt, Airflow, Kubernetes, Terraform). You architect alongside engineering, not just consume.

  • Communication and presence. Drive clarity in ambiguous situations. Translate complex analysis into decisions. Bring stakeholders along.

Why Almedia

  • Grow at Almedia: profitable from launch, higher revenue per employee than Big Tech.

  • Sharp, small team: we keep it small on purpose, every hire raises the bar.

  • Equity: every Berlin employee gets a stake.

  • Top of market baseline. Deliver outlier impact, earn accordingly.

What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth and expansion efforts in the Turkish market. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

  • Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

  • Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond.

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

  • You speak Turkish on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right mindset. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

  • Strategic Communication: You can translate complex product features into quantified ROI for Monetization and LiveOps leaders at major game studios.

  • High-Stakes Leadership: You give candid feedback, address performance early, and know how to keep a remote or multi-geo team (Berlin/China/Israel) engaged and hungry.

  • Operational Rigor: You don’t just "do sales"—you build systems. You are a power user of CRM data and live by pipeline hygiene.

  • Own Everything: You care deeply about the team's performance and see every roadblock as an opportunity to build a better process.

  • Move Fast: You thrive in the ambiguity of an early-stage environment and can pivot strategies without losing momentum.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Product Engineer (Client Platform)

(€70K – €95K)

We're looking for a Product Engineer to develop our Client Platform: A system to handle and allow our Clients to operate all of their work easily with us.

The goal is to build a minimal, usable platform that lets clients do every important action themselves. It automates what can be automated and makes the rest easy to see and act on.

Our Client Platform sits at the core of our business, so what you build will directly shape how our clients work with us every day.

Tech Stack

  • Python + FastAPI

  • TypeScript + NestJS, NextJS

  • dbt, BigQuery, Hex, PostgreSQL, MongoDB

  • Google Cloud Platform

What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Develop self-serve application features for our Business Clients & Internal Growth Management Team,

  • Own the data, backend & frontend implementation for your domains, interface clearly with Data, Engineering & Growth Teams,

  • Leverage LLMs, and chat agents while maintaining your own understanding of what you built at the correct layer of abstraction & actively contribute to our AI Engineering environment.

  • Experience with our tech stack or similar tools

  • A passion for building features end to end, from backend logic to the user interface

  • Comfort with AI-assisted development and agent-based coding tools in your daily workflow

  • A habit of keeping systems strictly typed, documented and organized

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Salary: 120-160k • Total Comp: 200k

We're looking for a highly analytical, data-driven Director of Customer Lifecycle (CRM) who will architect a sophisticated, machine-learning-adjacent customer lifecycle engine designed to maximize long-term retention and engagement across our global user base.

Your mission is to bring structure, rigorous experimentation, and algorithmic scalability to a CRM system that is complex by nature — with many entry points, diverse user flows, and a high bar for automation. You will sit at the intersection of marketing, product, and data science, moving comfortably from high-level retention strategy to hands-on pipeline and campaign execution.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Own Lifecycle Architecture & First-Day Experience: Own the full CRM strategy, with a heavy emphasis on mapping day-0 (d0) user behavior to optimize early-stage retention and long-term user monetization.

  • Build Algorithmic Personalization: Move beyond static batch-and-blast and basic segmentation. You will collaborate with Data Science to deploy predictive logic, user-level personalization models, and behavioral triggers across Email, Push, SMS, and In-App.

  • Drive Rigorous Experimentation: Establish a world-class testing culture. You will design, execute, and analyze systematic experiments that look past surface-level metrics to measure true incrementality and downstream KPI impact (e.g., Day-30, Day-90 retention).

  • Partner on Data Schema: Work directly with Data and Engineering to design, audit, and optimize the CRM data schema, ensuring real-time event tracking is clean, correctly mapped, and actionable.

  • Execute & Scale: While you own the strategy, you are also the primary operator in the early stages. You will build, troubleshoot, and optimize complex logic loops and API-triggered campaigns yourself.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Data Fluency & Measurement Rigor: You speak the same language as data scientists. You have a deep understanding of statistical significance, multi-variant testing, and how to isolate incremental lift.

  • Hands-on Platform Mastery: Mastery of omnichannel orchestration platforms (e.g., Braze). You have a proven track record of personally building complex liquid logic, API-triggered webhooks, and multi-step Canvas flows without needing an intermediary team to execute for you.

  • Complex Data Architecture Instincts: You know how to structure customer data so it scales. You can pinpoint exactly when a downstream personalization failure is an execution problem versus an underlying data pipeline or schema issue.

  • High-Volume B2C Experience: Experience managing high-volume engagement at companies with large, active user bases where lifecycle complexity is real and data clean-room hygiene is paramount.

  • Bonus: Experience overhauling a fragmented, "spaghetti-logic" CRM setup into a clean, scalable lifecycle engine, or experience writing basic SQL to query your own engagement data.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Full Stack & Hands-on Ownership: You take complete accountability for the post-install world. If a flow breaks or a tracking event drops off, you are eager to jump into the data logs, diagnose the issue, and fix it yourself.

  • Product-Led Retention Mindset: You look at CRM through a product lens. You understand that great retention starts at onboarding (d0) and that communication instruments are an extension of the product experience.

  • Thrive in Building Phases: You are comfortable working in a high-growth environment where data frameworks are still evolving. You can hold a vision for predictive, automated systems while building tight, pragmatic short-term workflows that don't add technical debt.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.
